background_image_description: Four people stand behind a white table against a plain white wall. From left to right: a man with short brown hair and a gray and blue striped sweater; a woman with blonde hair and a black sweater; a man with curly brown hair and a dark blue shirt over a white shirt; and a woman with brown hair and glasses wearing a blue and orange striped sweater.

nodes.asset_description: Four people are gathered around a white table against a plain white wall. The person on the far left wears a light blue and white striped shirt and blue jeans, holding a small object in their hands. Next to them, a person with blonde hair wears a black long-sleeved shirt. The third person has dark curly hair and is wearing a dark blue jacket over a white shirt. The fourth person has dark curly hair and is wearing a blue sweater with orange and blue stripes. A piece of paper lies on the table near the person on the right. The group appears to be engaged in conversation, though their expressions are not clearly visible.
A blue horizontal line spans the width of the image, positioned centrally. Above and below the line, the background is solid black.
